originalTitle: New York City man charged with hate crimes after alleged synagogue assault
summary: Police say Larry Montes struck a woman and a security guard after he disrupted Shabbat services
content: A New York City man is facing hate crime charges after police say he assaulted a woman and a security team member while disrupting Shabbat services at Central Synagogue in Manhattan – all in plain view of a live stream. The New York police department identified the suspect in the case as Larry Montes, 46, who was arrested after the episode at the synagogue. Montes was charged with two counts of assault as a hate crime and one count of criminal mischief as a hate crime, along with other alleged violations, police said. The incident unfolded just after 6pm on Saturday as services were getting under way at Central Synagogue, located on New York City’s busy Lexington Avenue. According to the NYPD commissioner, Jessica Tisch, security was attempting to remove Montes from the synagogue when he struck a 63-year-old woman, damaged synagogue property, and spit at and head-butted a member of the security team. Police said the woman suffered a small laceration to her lip and an injury to her right forearm. An NYPD sergeant assigned to the synagogue immediately intervened and took Montes into police custody, Tisch said. A live stream of the service captured the tense moments inside the synagogue. It showed a man shouting as a security guard tried to restrain him and remove him from the building. Tisch said there were no additional suspects being sought. “I understand the sanctity of this space and its meaning for congregants,” Tisch wrote on X on Saturday evening. “Central Synagogue is where I grew up. “In joy and in sorrow, it has always been a place of comfort and peace. What happened there tonight is deeply painful. A place of worship should never be a crime scene.” The NYPD’s hate crime taskforce is investigating the case. New York City’s mayor, Zohran Mamdani, condemned the attack, writing on X: “Every New Yorker must be able to observe their religion without fear of violence. This despicable act has no place in our city, and our administration will do everything in our power to keep Jewish New Yorkers safe.” Mamdani added that there was “no known ongoing threat in or around the synagogue”. New York’s governor, Kathy Hochul, also responded to the allegations against Montes, calling them “appalling” on X and writing: “Jewish New Yorkers have every right to worship openly, proudly, and without fear.” A statement from Central Synagogue pledged to “keep on gathering for joyful, meaningful Judaism with our … family every week”.
chineseTitle: 纽约市男子因涉嫌袭击犹太教堂而被指控犯有仇恨罪
chineseSummary: 警方称拉里·蒙特斯在扰乱安息日仪式后袭击了一名妇女和一名保安
chineseContent: 一名纽约市男子面临仇恨犯罪指控，警方称他在曼哈顿中央犹太教堂扰乱安息日仪式时袭击了一名妇女和一名安保人员，所有这一切都在现场直播中清晰可见。纽约警察局确认该案嫌疑人为 46 岁的拉里·蒙特斯 (Larry Montes)，他在犹太教堂事件发生后被捕。警方称，蒙特斯被指控犯有两项仇恨犯罪袭击罪和一项仇恨犯罪刑事恶作剧罪，以及其他涉嫌违法行为。这起事件发生在周六下午 6 点刚过，当时位于纽约市繁忙的列克星敦大道的中央犹太教堂正在举行礼拜活动。据纽约市警察局局长杰西卡·蒂施 (Jessica Tisch) 称，保安人员试图将蒙特斯带出犹太教堂时，蒙特斯袭击了一名 63 岁的妇女，损坏了犹太教堂的财产，并向一名保安人员吐口水并用头撞了他。警方称，这名女子的嘴唇有轻微撕裂伤，右前臂也受伤。蒂施说，一名派驻该犹太教堂的纽约市警察局警官立即介入，并将蒙特斯拘留。仪式的现场直播捕捉到了犹太教堂内的紧张时刻。视频显示，一名男子大喊大叫，一名保安试图制止他并将他带出大楼。蒂施表示，目前尚未追捕其他嫌疑人。 “我理解这个空间的神圣性及其对会众的意义，”蒂施周六晚上在 X 上写道。 “中央犹太教堂是我长大的地方。“无论欢乐还是悲伤，它始终是一个舒适与和平的地方。今晚发生的事情令人深感痛苦。礼拜场所绝不应该成为犯罪现场。”纽约警察局的仇恨犯罪特别工作组正在调查此案。纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 谴责了这一行为
